detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: This revised analysis synthesizes the algebraic conditions for persistent autocatalytic subnetworks with the thermodynamic requirements for heritable information. Persistence in non-equilibrium reaction networks can be characterized by specific stoichiometric submatrix criteria, providing a structural foundation for units of heredity that precede template-directed replication.
detail.reason: Revision incorporating stoichiometric algebraic conditions into the heredity threshold framework, fulfilling the requirement for upgraded evidence in proj-heredity-thresholds-01.
